question: Do coral_centroid_loss + --w-coral + the grl-lambda-target schedule lower G2 sport-decodability, and at what cost to G1/G3/rank?
design: PAIRED. Same three seeds (7/11/13), same 60 epochs, same --w-task 2.0 --w-sport 0.5 --grl-lambda 0.3 --grl-ramp 10. The ONLY difference is the three flags under test. Both arms select the checkpoint the same way, so the min-over-epochs selection bias is symmetric.
VERDICT: SPORT IS NO LONGER DECODABLE ABOVE THE BASE RATE under the full treatment. That is the result; the paired difference is not. Residual decodability (sport_acc minus majority_class_share) is -0.0022 with 95% CI [-0.0060, +0.0016] — bounded at +0.0016. The control is decodable at +0.0829 (p=0.0304). The lambda-only arm is UNDETERMINED, not at the floor: its upper bound is +0.0613. THE PAIRED MEAN IS THE WRONG SUMMARY of this experiment (-0.0851, p=0.0251, 5/5 seeds): the treated arm is pinned at the floor (sd 0.0030) while the control spans 0.6614-0.7782 (sd 0.0564), a 343x variance ratio (F p=0.00005) that is a floor effect, so the difference measures which controls were drawn. The lambda schedule is 66% of it and is significant (p=0.0122); the coral/centroid term is NOT (p=0.0659). Nothing promoted. The n=3 floors this file once published were CORRECTED — see CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was_the_n9_one; every constant here now comes from scipy.stats.t.ppf(0.975, df).
CORRECTION_the_costs_were_a_BASELINE_ART: Before the control ran I reported G3 silhouette -0.0610 and G1 hoops -0.0201 as the price of sport-blindness, measured against the shipped 0.6851 report. Both vanish under pairing: G3 silhouette -0.0154 with sd_of_differences 0.0309 (inside its own noise) and G1 hoops +0.0006 with sd 0.0081 (nil). The shipped baseline was ONE draw of a DIFFERENT config — it uses --grl-lambda 0.05, not 0.3 — so differences against it were never attributable to the flags under test. Three treatment seeds against one baseline run is the same asymmetry this repo keeps finding, and I published it before catching it.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_ISOLATE: The paired effect is the COMBINED effect of all three flags. The control ramps lambda 0 -> 0.3; the treatment ramps 0.3 -> 0.5 AND adds both coral terms. Separating the centroid term from the lambda schedule needs a third arm that was not run. The shipped 0.6851 (lambda 0.05) vs this control's 0.6679 mean suggests the lambda increase alone already moves G2, so attributing all -0.0458 to the centroid term would be wrong.
n_is_3: SUPERSEDED by n_is_5. Kept because a CORRECTION_ block declares this field as its target, and removing a correction's target is not the same as landing the correction. Original meaning: the seed count and floor discussion for the 3-seed version of this artifact, whose floors were built with the wrong t constant.

CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was.what_was_published: Every paired floor in this file was 2.31 * sd_d / sqrt(3); the headline read '3.9x the paired MDE(n=3) 0.0116'.
CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was.what_is_wrong: 2.31 is t(0.975, df=8) -- the n=9 constant, used at n=3. A paired test on 3 seeds has df=2, where the two-sided constant is t(0.975,2)=4.303. Every floor here was too small by 1.863x.
CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was.blast_radius: 8 stat blocks, not just the headline: G1_gridiron, G1_hoops, G1_pitch, G2_delta_vs_majority, G2_sport_acc, G3_separation, G3_silhouette, effective_rank.
CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was.conclusions_that_flip: NONE. All 8 blocks keep their verdict. The wrong constant inflated the MARGINS, it did not reverse a decision -- G2 still clears (2.12x, p=0.0118) and every cost field was already below its floor and sits further below now. The correction is to the reported effect size, not to the finding.
CORRECTION_the_paired_floor_constant_was.found_by: checking the constant against scipy before reusing it in the decomposition -- not by anything downstream catching it.

DECOMPOSITION.why: WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_ISOLATE said the -0.0458 was the combined effect of three flags and that separating them needed a third arm that was not run. It has now been run. This is that separation.

arms.LAM: lambda 0.3->0.5, no coral (the arm that was missing)

DECOMPOSITION.floors_are_per_effect: Each effect is tested on its OWN differences -- its own sd, its own se, its own CI. Reusing the total's floor for a component would be a real number answering a different question.

MULTIPLICITY_the_coral_term_does_not_sur.why_raised: Two effects are tested on one dataset. The coral term's p=0.0659 clears a naive 0.05 and does NOT clear a Bonferroni-corrected 0.025 for 2 comparisons. Reporting it as SIGNIFICANT without saying that would be the same overstatement the floor-constant correction above just fixed.
MULTIPLICITY_the_coral_term_does_not_sur.honest_reading: The lambda schedule is the effect. It is 78% of the total, significant at any correction applied here, and consistent across all 3 seeds. The coral/centroid term contributes a real-looking but SMALL residual (-0.0102) whose significance is not robust to a multiplicity correction at n=3. Crediting the headline to the centroid loss -- which is the term I wrote and would most like to be the cause -- is not supported. The cheap fix is seeds, not argument: at n=5 the coral term either clears a corrected threshold or it does not.

CORRECTION_the_floor_constant_was_wrong.what_was_published: The -0.0458 was reported as clearing the paired MDE(n=3) 0.0116 by 3.9x, computed as 2.31 * sd_d / sqrt(3).
CORRECTION_the_floor_constant_was_wrong.what_is_wrong: 2.31 is t(0.975, df=8) -- the n=9 constant, used at n=3. A paired test on 3 seeds has df=2, where the two-sided constant is t(0.975,2)=4.303.
CORRECTION_the_floor_constant_was_wrong.does_the_finding_survive: YES. p=0.0251, CI [-0.1527, -0.0174] excludes 0, and the sign is consistent across all 5 seeds. What does NOT survive is the SIZE of the margin: 2.12x, not 3.9x.
CORRECTION_the_floor_constant_was_wrong.found_by: checking my own constant against scipy before reusing it in the decomposition, not by anything downstream catching it.

n_is_5: 5 seeds, df=4. Blocks regenerated from the per-seed reports rather than edited in place. Verdicts that changed against the n=3 version: NONE (that count covers the 8 A/B blocks only, NOT the decomposition -- see N5_CONFIRMATION.SCOPE_of_that_NONE).

VARIANCE_CLAMP_reframes_the_headline.finding: The treated arm lands at 0.6236 +/- 0.0030 every seed. The control spans 0.6614 to 0.7782. The treatment is not shifting G2 by a fixed amount -- it is CLAMPING it to a floor while the control wanders.
VARIANCE_CLAMP_reframes_the_headline.why_the_mean_difference_is_the_wrong_sum: If the treated arm is near-constant, the paired difference is just (constant - control), so the headline mean difference is a statement about WHICH CONTROLS WERE DRAWN, not about the size of a treatment effect. The controls here are bimodal ([0.6614, 0.666, 0.6762] vs [0.7616, 0.7782]); a different split of those two basins across 5 seeds moves the headline substantially.
VARIANCE_CLAMP_reframes_the_headline.the_correlation_is_NOT_independent_evide: corr(control baseline, paired difference) = -0.999. This is NOT a second finding and must not be cited as corroboration. If the treated arm is a constant c then diff = c - ctrl and the correlation is -1 by arithmetic. Reporting it as support would be a real number answering a different question than the one it appears to answer -- the defect this whole file is about. The load-bearing measurement is the variance ratio, not the correlation.

N5_CONFIRMATION.SCOPE_of_that_NONE: It covers ONLY the 8 control-vs-treatment blocks above. It does NOT cover the DECOMPOSITION, where the headline change happened: the coral term went from p=0.0298 (significant) at n=3 to p=0.0659 (NOT significant) at n=5. Read alone, 'verdict_changes: NONE' would say nothing changed, which is false.
N5_CONFIRMATION.why: The n=3 result flagged the coral term as one seed-pair from flipping (p=0.0298, failing a Bonferroni 0.025). This is the confirmation run, and it flipped.

what_the_confirmation_found.coral_term: DID NOT CONFIRM. p 0.0298 -> 0.0659, CI now spans 0 [-0.0608,+0.0030]. The centroid loss I wrote is not separable from noise at n=5, before any multiplicity correction. At n=3 it looked real; it was not.
what_the_confirmation_found.lambda_schedule: CONFIRMED. p 0.0094 -> 0.0122, still significant, still the majority of the effect (78% at n=3, 66% at n=5).
what_the_confirmation_found.headline_G2: CONFIRMED IN SIGN, but the magnitude nearly doubled (-0.0458 -> -0.0851) purely because 2 of 5 controls landed in a high basin. See VARIANCE_CLAMP_reframes_the_headline: the treated arm is near-constant, so this mean is a fact about the control draw, not a stable effect size.

FLOOR_ANALYSIS_is_sport_still_decodable_.question: Not 'did G2 drop' but 'is sport decodable above the majority-class base rate (0.6258) at all'. A drop of any size is uninteresting if the arm is still decodable, and a drop is unnecessary if it is already at the floor.
FLOOR_ANALYSIS_is_sport_still_decodable_.reading: CTRL is decodable above the base rate (p=0.0304). FULL is not, and its interval is TIGHT: residual decodability is at most +0.0016. That is evidence of absence, not merely absence of evidence.
FLOOR_ANALYSIS_is_sport_still_decodable_.LAM_and_FULL_are_not_the_same_null: Both fail to reject at 0.05, and treating that as 'both reached the floor' would be wrong. LAM's upper bound is +0.0613; FULL's is +0.0016, about 38x tighter. LAM is UNDETERMINED -- it could still be substantially decodable and this n cannot tell. FULL is bounded.
FLOOR_ANALYSIS_is_sport_still_decodable_.does_this_rescue_the_coral_term: NO, and it must not be read that way. The paired coral effect is still p=0.0659, which does not clear 0.05. What this adds is that the ARM CONTAINING the coral terms is demonstrably at the floor while the lambda-only arm is not demonstrably anywhere. Those are different claims and only the first is established.
FLOOR_ANALYSIS_is_sport_still_decodable_.explains_the_variance_clamp: The 343x variance ratio is a FLOOR EFFECT, not a mysterious basin: an arm sitting on the majority-class base rate cannot vary downward, so its spread collapses. The control has room to wander and does.
